x: We hope to see Charlie Walker out again in the New Year. The tragic loss of his 4 year old daughter in October has naturally curtailed his activities.
Nice to see two sons of Club members, Ivan Beaumont (son of Ray) and Stephen Walker (son of Chas.) running for the Club in the K.L.G. 3000 metres Cross-Country races for colts recently.
Leg nine saw our new Kiwi recruit Steve Walker, just back from a tour of Europe, running an excellent leg off long steady runs and no speed work.
